messages.subject: R_ZIPCMD not set by default on shinyapps.io?
parts:
A recommendation (/question to confirm I'm not missing something):

I recently found that a download button on my shinyapps.io Shiny app that provided a zip file no longer worked. After a whole lot of debugging, I found that R_ZIPCMD is not (or no longer?) set by default on shinyapps.io. Could RStudio make the zip and unzip tools at R_ZIPCMD and R_UNZIPCMD available by default on shinyapps.io apps? Or did I just mess something up?

This issue was particularly nettlesome because zipping a subdirectory of my app folder created an error that took a while to trace to the zip function ("sh: 1: : Permission denied") and that appeared only server-side (I'm working on Windows 10 otherwise). For a reproducible example, my app folder contains app.R (below) and a subfolder called "Exports" with a few dummy files (another.csv, dfname.csv,export1.csv, export2.csv,readme.txt in this case, though they're not explicitly referenced) (though I'd normally create these through a script, I wanted to isolate any folder or file creation issues from the zipping issue). Pressing "getdata" works locally, but not on shinyapps.io. 

 library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)


ui <- fluidPage(
  # Wrap the button in the function `withBusyIndicatorUI()`
  actionButton("run","Run me"),
  downloadButton(
    "downloadShp",
    "getdata")
)


server <- function(input, output, session) {
  print(getwd())
  print(list.files(getwd()))
  print(list.dirs(getwd()))
  print(list.files(file.path(getwd(),"Exports"),full.names = TRUE))
  print(Sys.info())
  print(sessionInfo())
  print(Sys.getenv())


  output$downloadShp <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() {paste0("dltest.zip")},
    content = function(file) {
     
      ziphere = dir("Exports",full.names = TRUE)
      print(ziphere)
     
      return(zip(zipfile = file,
                 files = ziphere))
    },
    contentType = "application/zip"
  )#end of download shp
 
  session$onSessionEnded(function() {


  })
}


shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)

What's a little challenging is that when zipping the Exports subfolder, the error returned is "sh: 1: : Permission denied", not something about not having zip tools at hand. I recently found that a download button on my shinyapps.io Shiny app that provided a zip file no longer worked. After a whole lot of debugging, I found that R_ZIPCMD is not (or no longer?) set by default on shinyapps.io. Could RStudio make the zip and unzip tools at R_ZIPCMD and R_UNZIPCMD available by default on shinyapps.io apps? Or did I just mess something up?

This issue was particularly nettlesome because zipping a subdirectory of my app folder created an error that took a while to trace to the zip function ("sh: 1: : Permission denied") and that appeared only server-side (I'm working on Windows 10 otherwise). For a reproducible example, my app folder contains app.R (below) and a subfolder called "Exports" with a few dummy files (another.csv, dfname.csv,export1.csv, export2.csv,readme.txt in this case, though they're not explicitly referenced) (though I'd normally create these through a script, I wanted to isolate any folder or file creation issues from the zipping issue). Pressing "getdata" works locally, but not on shinyapps.io. 

 library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)


ui <- fluidPage(
  # Wrap the button in the function `withBusyIndicatorUI()`
  actionButton("run","Run me"),
  downloadButton(
    "downloadShp",
    "getdata")
)


server <- function(input, output, session) {
  print(getwd())
  print(list.files(getwd()))
  print(list.dirs(getwd()))
  print(list.files(file.path(getwd(),"Exports"),full.names = TRUE))
  print(Sys.info())
  print(sessionInfo())
  print(Sys.getenv())


  output$downloadShp <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() {paste0("dltest.zip")},
    content = function(file) {
     
      ziphere = dir("Exports",full.names = TRUE)
      print(ziphere)
     
      return(zip(zipfile = file,
                 files = ziphere))
    },
    contentType = "application/zip"
  )#end of download shp
 
  session$onSessionEnded(function() {


  })
}


shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)

What's a little challenging is that when zipping the Exports subfolder, the error returned is "sh: 1: : Permission denied", not something about not having zip tools at hand. This issue was particularly nettlesome because zipping a subdirectory of my app folder created an error that took a while to trace to the zip function ("sh: 1: : Permission denied") and that appeared only server-side (I'm working on Windows 10 otherwise). For a reproducible example, my app folder contains app.R (below) and a subfolder called "Exports" with a few dummy files (another.csv, dfname.csv,export1.csv, export2.csv,readme.txt in this case, though they're not explicitly referenced) (though I'd normally create these through a script, I wanted to isolate any folder or file creation issues from the zipping issue). Pressing "getdata" works locally, but not on shinyapps.io. 

 library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)


ui <- fluidPage(
  # Wrap the button in the function `withBusyIndicatorUI()`
  actionButton("run","Run me"),
  downloadButton(
    "downloadShp",
    "getdata")
)


server <- function(input, output, session) {
  print(getwd())
  print(list.files(getwd()))
  print(list.dirs(getwd()))
  print(list.files(file.path(getwd(),"Exports"),full.names = TRUE))
  print(Sys.info())
  print(sessionInfo())
  print(Sys.getenv())


  output$downloadShp <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() {paste0("dltest.zip")},
    content = function(file) {
     
      ziphere = dir("Exports",full.names = TRUE)
      print(ziphere)
     
      return(zip(zipfile = file,
                 files = ziphere))
    },
    contentType = "application/zip"
  )#end of download shp
 
  session$onSessionEnded(function() {


  })
}


shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)

A recommendation (/question to confirm I'm not missing something):

I recently found that a download button on my shinyapps.io Shiny app that provided a zip file no longer worked. After a whole lot of debugging, I found that R_ZIPCMD is not (or no longer?) set by default on shinyapps.io. Could RStudio make the zip and unzip tools at R_ZIPCMD and R_UNZIPCMD available by default on shinyapps.io apps? Or did I just mess something up?

This issue was particularly nettlesome because zipping a subdirectory of my app folder created an error that took a while to trace to the zip function ("sh: 1: : Permission denied") and that appeared only server-side (I'm working on Windows 10 otherwise). For a reproducible example, my app folder contains app.R (below) and a subfolder called "Exports" with a few dummy files (another.csv, dfname.csv,export1.csv, export2.csv,readme.txt in this case, though they're not explicitly referenced) (though I'd normally create these through a script, I wanted to isolate any folder or file creation issues from the zipping issue). Pressing "getdata" works locally, but not on shinyapps.io. 

 library(shiny)
library(tidyverse)


ui <- fluidPage(
  # Wrap the button in the function `withBusyIndicatorUI()`
  actionButton("run","Run me"),
  downloadButton(
    "downloadShp",
    "getdata")
)


server <- function(input, output, session) {
  print(getwd())
  print(list.files(getwd()))
  print(list.dirs(getwd()))
  print(list.files(file.path(getwd(),"Exports"),full.names = TRUE))
  print(Sys.info())
  print(sessionInfo())
  print(Sys.getenv())


  output$downloadShp <- downloadHandler(
    filename = function() {paste0("dltest.zip")},
    content = function(file) {
     
      ziphere = dir("Exports",full.names = TRUE)
      print(ziphere)
     
      return(zip(zipfile = file,
                 files = ziphere))
    },
    contentType = "application/zip"
  )#end of download shp
 
  session$onSessionEnded(function() {


  })
}


shinyApp(ui = ui, server = server)

What's a little challenging is that when zipping the Exports subfolder, the error returned is "sh: 1: : Permission denied", not something about not having zip tools at hand.
